U_0x00E122.en: A general-purpose battle carrier converted from humanity's first deep-space exploration vessel, the Hiryuu. It was also the first ship fitted with a <Tesla Drive>. In New Era 179, it was attacked by a fleet of <Aerogater> mobile weapons in the space beyond Pluto's orbit and suffered moderate damage; after paying a heavy price, it returned to Icarus Base in the asteroid belt. It later underwent a major refit based on the "ISA" (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a lightning assault combining a mobile battleship acting as a carrier with the humanoid mobile weapons it carries) tactical doctrine, being reborn as the general-purpose battle carrier "Hiryuu Kai." Its bow is fitted with a super-gravity impact cannon derived from <EOT> technology, giving it combat capability second only to Hagane and Kurogane. Its codename is "Dragon 2."

U_0x00E871.en: Aerial combat carrier used by the <Earth Fed Army> and others. Fighters and <Armored Module>s launch and land in flight; air defenses and armament make it a flying fortress.

U_0x00E9BA.en: A large strategic transport plane of the <Earth Fed Army>. It carries up to five <Personal Trooper>s to the front, and its launch catapult lets <Personal Trooper>s sortie in flight for rapid deployment.

U_0x00EB56.en: First of the 'Dynamic General Guardian' series ('Double G'), humanoid weapons designed by Dr. Bian Zoldark, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>), to defend the <Earth Cradle>. A sword and melee unit, its 'DML System' and dedicated OS 'JINKI-1' unite pilot and machine. Its 'ABMD (artificial musculoskeletal drive) System' yields far more supple, dynamic motion than same-size humanoid weapons.

U_0x01230C.en:
8A humanoid mobile weapon of the Gaia Sabers' Alpha Saber squad, developed from the captured "Lestgemira" (Earth codename: Geminira), an unmanned variable mobile weapon of the <Inspectors>. Its flexible frame and wide-range joints give high mobility and responsiveness; the transformation mechanism was omitted to cut costs.
The Altarf adds large command wings with a high-performance <Tesla Drive>, and its Double Gunnery (live rounds and beams) is a long-barrel version with a large bayonet.

U_0x015327.en: Second machine of the Valsion series, developed by <DC> leader Bian Zoldark for his daughter Lune. Artificial muscles transmit power through the frame, giving it flexible, human-like movement (even facial expressions) far beyond any <Personal Trooper> or <Armored Module>. A compact, improved <Tesla Drive> allows independent flight. Armed with the wide-area Psycho Blaster plus the Cross Smasher and Divine Arm from the Valsion, its combat power is very high. The DML (Direct Motion Link) control system lets pilot and machine move as one.
